review: Chief Maid Ryoshu is an interesting and strong Poise-focused Identity. She is focused on taking care of groups of enemies and her effectiveness goes down a bit against single bosses. Chief Maid Ryoshu skills roll up to 11 on S1, 16 on S2, and 18 on S3 in clashes, and they can go up to 14/19/23 respectively if the conditions are fulfilled. The main appeal of Chief Maid Ryoshu is her S2, which gains +2 Attack Weight by consuming 6 Poise Count on herself, making it hit 3 enemies. Her S3 can also be reused on another target if its last coin kills an enemy and if there's another enemy with B.M. Her Poise Count and gain are entirely self-sufficient, often generating more than enough to make the Poise Count cost on her S2 negligible, combined with the fact that she has a low amount of coins across all of her skills, meaning she won't chew through her Poise Count by getting crits on every hit. A
